question: Choose the correctly spelt word:
solution:
The correct answer is **option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correctly spelt word among the options is **'Vogue.'**
 
• **Vogue** is a noun meaning "the prevailing fashion or style at a particular time" or "general acceptance or favor." **(फैशन या लोकप्रियता)**
 
• Examples of usage:
 
 
• The magazine is famous for showcasing the latest vogue in the fashion industry.
 
• The use of eco-friendly products is coming into vogue these days.
 
 
 
• The other options are incorrect because they are misspellings:
 
 
• **Voug:** Incorrect spelling.
 
• **Vougue:** Incorrect spelling.
 
• **Vog:** Incorrect spelling.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The word **Vogue** originated from the Old French word "voguer," which means "to sail or to be in fashion."
 
• It is widely used in contexts related to fashion, trends, or popularity.
 
• Synonyms for vogue include **trend, fashion, style,** and **fad.**
